goal.text: v5 keeps evidence linked, fresh, and independent
goal.reason: the console, its local browser page and the scripts of the project are part of the method, not exempt from it

claims.text: pure verdict laws and freshness
claims.falsifier: a broken verdict or freshness rule passes
claims.control: sed -i 's/| Red, _ | _, Red -> Red/| Red, _ | _, Red -> Green/' lib/verdict.ml

claims.text: strict versioned JSON codecs
claims.falsifier: an unknown, duplicate, or legacy-invalid field is accepted
claims.control: sed -i 's/| key :: _, _ -> Error (what ^ ": unknown field " ^ key)/| key :: _, _ -> Ok pairs/' format/json_helpers.ml

claims.text: the CLI produces fresh independent evidence
claims.falsifier: a claim holds without current independent evidence

claims.text: ADR and JUnit are imported read-only with provenance
claims.falsifier: an import writes the source or loses nested evidence

claims.text: MCP returns typed JSON-RPC results and actionable errors
claims.falsifier: a result is prose instead of structured JSON or an invalid protocol is accepted

claims.text: protected transitions and the measurement stand work on installed tools
claims.falsifier: an unauthorized transition passes or the stand cannot find mathc
claims.control: sed -i 's/match Sys.getenv_opt "MATHC" with/match Some "\/definitely-missing-mathc" with/' bin/stand.ml

claims.text: installed mathc and stand work together
claims.falsifier: an installed tool cannot run or stand cannot find mathc

claims.text: portable mathc and stand run outside the Nix store
claims.falsifier: a portable binary needs Nix store paths or cannot run
claims.control: sed -i 's/dune build --root . bin\/mathc.exe bin\/stand.exe/dune build --root . missing-target/' flake.nix

claims.text: repository structure and public interfaces stay bounded
claims.falsifier: a core or interface exceeds its bound or loses required files

claims.text: local binaries, agent skill, and canonical methodology install cleanly
claims.falsifier: the installer succeeds but a binary, skill, or canonical methodology is missing or unusable

claims.text: an installed agent can integrate no-ADR and MADR projects

requirements.spec: nix build .#default .#stand --no-link && MATHC="$(nix path-info .#default)/bin/mathc" MATHC_STAND="$(nix path-info .#stand)/bin/stand" sh test/agent_onboarding.sh

claims.falsifier: the onboarding path passes without exercising the actual workflow

claims.text: the delivery workflow is valid
claims.falsifier: an invalid workflow passes validation

claims.text: the site is generated from spec.json and the live map and shows every claim with its current state
claims.falsifier: a claim is missing from the rendered map or shows a state that mathc map does not report

claims.text: the navigation keeps every item and every frame on a phone screen, and the English and the Russian pages are drawn by the same typefaces
claims.falsifier: a navigation item or a button is cut off on a phone screen, or the English and the Russian pages are drawn by different typefaces

claims.text: the field pilot ledger accepts consistent records and rejects inconsistent comparisons
claims.falsifier: an inconsistent task record is accepted or a valid dry run is rejected
claims.control: sed -i 's/accepted_by is None/accepted_by is not None/' docs/measurements/task-ledger.py

claims.text: the Math Coding console shows the canonical map only, keeps the host boundary explicit and refuses to invent a reason
claims.falsifier: the console computes a verdict or a claim state on its own, or the shared interface imports the host package directly

claims.text: the development shell keeps stdout free of prose, so the machine interface stays machine readable
claims.falsifier: the notice of the development shell reaches stdout, or the map stops being the only thing on stdout

claims.text: the runner notices a finished child at once and never adds a delay of its own
claims.falsifier: a child that ends at once is noticed late, or a child that runs long is not waited for
claims.control: sed -i 's/let pause = ref 0.002/let pause = ref 0.05/' adapter/process.ml

claims.text: the console opens with the queue of the human: the expectations, the checks, the evidence and the state come from the canonical map, and the queue never computes a state of its own
claims.falsifier: the queue shows a state that the canonical map does not state, or it hides a condition of a declared claim

claims.text: the console shows the files of the subject inside the repository and reads no file outside it
claims.falsifier: the panel reads a file outside the workspace, or it follows a symbolic link out of the repository

claims.text: the development shell is ready for work: its tools come from the store, the node of the shell is taken from the binary cache, and the shell stays in the store
claims.falsifier: the node of the development shell is compiled from the sources, or the collector of garbage takes the shell away

claims.text: the local browser page is one interface: the bundle holds one copy of the shared interface and one copy of the data layer, and the page renders the queue of the human
claims.falsifier: the page carries a second copy of the interface or of the data layer, or the page does not render the queue of the human

claims.text: the console shows the manual steps of the method and performs them through the program itself: the human decides, the program records
claims.falsifier: the console performs a step the canonical map does not offer, or it performs a decision without the explicit confirmation of the human

claims.text: the console opens the sheet of the host with the surface of the host inside it: the claim detail of the queue, the confirmation of a run, the decision of the method and the preview of a file stay readable in the host
claims.falsifier: the sheet of the host draws a view that the host cannot draw, or the surface of the host is missing inside the sheet
